en: Colorized historic postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with brick and stucco buildings behind a long wall with decorative pillars. The focus is on a large red-brick complex with gabled roofs and arched windows, identified as a military barracks. The sky is tinted blue with light clouds, in a typical early 20th‑century postcard style. German text identifying the town, street, and building is printed at the top.
